description: This file defines the 'Session' class within the OpenCart system library namespace. It provides methods for managing user sessions, including starting, getting session ID, closing, destroying, and garbage collection, with support for different session adaptors.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: A class to manage user sessions within the OpenCart system, supporting different session storage adaptors and handling session lifecycle operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the session object with the specified adaptor and registry, and loads the session adaptor class.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a session with an optional session ID, generating a new one if not provided, and loads session data.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Writes the session data to storage, effectively closing the session.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes the current session from storage.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection for session cleanup.
